query: Why did I get a 3-month extension for my current LTVP?
reference_answer: Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) renewal applicants who are eligible for the LTVP extension will receive an email notification to inform you on the 3-month extension for your current LTVP. This is an interim arrangement while we process your LTVP renewal application. We will inform you the outcome of your renewal application via email.
answer: Without specific information, I can't provide an exact reason. However, typically, extensions like these are given due to unforeseen circumstances affecting performance, such as health issues, family emergencies, or personal development needs. [Document N]
